name: Text Label Generator
description: Advanced PCB text label and icon generator with TrueType font support.
description_full:
A powerful tool to create high-quality text labels and icons for KiCad PCBs. Features include:

- **TrueType Font Support**: Use any TTF/OTF font for text labels.
- **Symbol/Icon Picker**: Integrated browser for symbol fonts (FontAwesome, etc.).
- **Rich Text Support**: Mix multiple fonts in a single label using tags.
- **Negative Rendering**: Create inverted text (copper/mask cutouts) automatically.
- **Custom Borders**: Square, Round, Hexagon, Ribbon, and more.
- **Live Preview**: Real-time rendering with zoom and pan.
- **Direct Export**: Copy directly to clipboard or save as .kicad_mod footprint.
